core.title: Automatic Release Door Flip Guard, Don-Jo 1606
tags: assa abloy HW-102-MS US antique dark

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1606, Automatic Release Hotel Door Flip Guard

All the new hotels are installing this Automatic Release Door Flip Guard because it keeps their guests safe while protecting their doors from damage that traditional security flip guards can cause. The Hotel Door Flip Guard is installed on the door frame. While a guest or homeowner is inside, they can flip the guard plate out and it will keep the door from being opened even when it is unlocked, just like a traditional security door guard. However, this one has an automatic release that keeps it from being used as a hold open stop. Where guests used to flip the guard arm into the door opening to keep it from closing and locking them out when they ran down the hall for ice--causing the door and the guard damage as they banged together--the Don-Jo 1606 Door Flip Guard automatically closes when the door does, keeping both free from damage. These are also great for use on fire doors that must remain closed since guests can no longer use the security flip guard to prop open the door.

Also Available: Flip Guard Angle Plate which is installed on the door edge to protect it from damage from the guard arm when it is left in the open position.

Features and Specifications of the Security Door Flip Guard:

  • Overall Length: 2-23/32"
  • Overall Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Flip Plate Length: 1-13/16"
  • Flip Plate Width: 1-7/16"
  • Mounting Plate Width: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting Plate Length: 2-11/16"
  • Ansi: L33042
  • Includes matching finish mounting screws.

Sold Individually
